I can reproduce the reported problem.
The problem seems to in the Kotlin version, if you update to `1.3.71` or `1.3.72` the problem goes away.

1. I have updated kotlin version `<kotlin.version>1.3.72</kotlin.version>` in pom project>properties.
2. run `mvnw quarkus:dev` open http://localhost:8080/api/test > "hello world" is correctly displayed
3. Change back in code main/kotlin/com/acme/test/MyResource "hello world" message by "hello" and go back to http://localhost:8080/api/test. RunTimeExceptions still occurs in the browser. Same message.

Have I missed something? - Thank you
Actually there seems to be some incompatibility between the Kotlin compiler and Tika. If you removed the tika extension things should work.

issue.title: Exclude Xerces dependency in Tika extension
issue.body:
Tika brings in a dependency that is incompatible with the APIs available during reload.  I think, long term, we should look at trying to recreate that initial classpath for use inside the dev plugin, but this fix will at least remove the errant dep and reloads once again work with tika enabled.

(the gradle dev plugin depends on the `classes` task which takes care of the initial compilation before handing this off to the plugin.  the classpath that the plugin assembles is different and so includes only the errant, old XML api causing the breakage.  If we could pass in/discover the `implementation` scope's classpath, we could solve this problem generically, I think.  But I lack the gradle mojo to make that happen just now.)

fixes #8708
